subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should owner-qualified `skills install --force` refuse to replace an existing tracked skill with the same slug but a different owner?
rationale: The patch prevents silent replacement of installed skill state and aligns install with update/verify owner checks, but it changes force-install semantics for any workflow that intentionally used cross-owner replacement.

options.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
options.body: Merge this PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

options.title: Require explicit owner-change flow
options.body: Ask for a deliberate override or migration path if cross-owner replacement should remain possible without silent clobbering.

options.title: Preserve current force behavior
options.body: Do not merge the guard if `--force` is intended to replace any same-slug install regardless of owner.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: This is both a ClawHub behavior and data-integrity decision, matching the listed ownership area in CONTRIBUTING.md.
